regime_context: China A-shares show a dominant one-narrative structure (银行/Banks) with 94% breadth, but only 2 of 22 themes (9%) are trend-eligible and the backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market (mean-reverting tape) — so even the one validated drawdown edge fails here. Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~zero, so ranks are an attention lens, not alpha; macro backdrop is AI-tech/geopolitics dominated with unscheduled share at 1.0 (surprise-driven headlines).
emerging_watch: Battery & Lithium (rank 20, score -0.515, breadth 0.0, crowding_z -1.45) — the most crowded-out, least-owned theme; watching for a confirmed base where breadth moves from 0.0 to sustained >0.3 AND score crosses above 0 without crowding re-spiking; that observable breadth turn would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the dominant trend-eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.87), highest breadth (0.944), and a crowding_z of 1.98 (crowded=true). The trend gate is the only validated drawdown-control leg, but the backtest says it did_NOT_hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so durability/breadth are coincident texture, not edge. Crowding is a size-down caution only, and at z=1.98 this is a saturated narrative — per guardrails do NOT fade it, but there is no reason to lean overweight on a coincident-led, crowded leader in a market where the gate itself whipsaws.
evidence: Banks rank 1, score 0.958, eligible=true, durability_bar 0.87 (highest), breadth 0.944
theses.dissent: Banks are the only broad-based, high-durability trend with genuine leadership; in a genuinely trend-following regime the focus lens would still justify overweight despite crowding, and the tracker's own hit rate is >50%.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS posts a new 60-day high AND breadth stays above 0.94 with crowding_z falling below 1.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the second eligible theme (score 0.887) but has a durability bar of only 0.47 with hurst_tag mean-revert and breadth 0.2 — a thin, mean-reverting tape rather than a coherent trend. In a market where the absolute-trend gate whipsaws, a mean-reverting secondary leader is a weak handoff candidate. Not a fade call — just no reason to treat it as a confirmed challenger while the rotation margin is thin (0.071) and absorption is only 0.35.
evidence: Coal rank 2, eligible=true, score 0.887, but durability_bar 0.47, hurst_tag mean-revert
theses.dissent: Coal is the only other eligible theme and a mean-revert tag in a mean-reverting market could actually be the more adaptive leg — the 0.887 score is real near-term leadership.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gains 8% relative to 512800.SS over any 15-trading-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: SOE Blue Chips (中特估)
theses.thesis: SOE Blue Chips rank 3 with durable trend (0.88) and breadth 0.75 but are eligible=false (trend gate already declined them) and crowding_z 1.7 crowded=true with no ETF proxy (scorable=false). The gate declining them in a market where the gate itself is unreliable is a double-negative; and with no scorable proxy this is an unscorable lean anyway. Marked avoid rather than underweight because there is no clean instrument to track and crowding is a size-down caution only.
evidence: eligible=false, durability_bar 0.88 (trend tag exists but gate declined)
gate_helps=false → do not treat gate decline as alpha
theses.dissent: The SOE/value complex is the core of this narrative (category Financials & Value) and the durable-but-ineligible flag may be a lag artifact in a mean-reverting tape; it could re-enter trend soon.

falsifier.text: A scorable SOE/value proxy appears AND its breadth rises above 0.8 AND eligibility flips true before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
